title: Claude Code + NotebookLM by Google = infinite memory
description:
Claude Code + NotebookLM by Google = infinite memory.

Not a bigger context window. A second brain. NotebookLM keeps your PDFs, your audio, every doc you throw at it, and Claude pulls from all of it without choking your local machine.

The bridge is one free GitHub repo, pre-installed as a skill, running a quiet Playwright script. Sign in with Google one time and you’re set 🚀

Drop “REPO” in the comments and it’s yours
